entries.snippet: The settlement resolves a lawsuit brought in 2024 that accused the healthcare giant of providing massive amounts of opioids and other controlled substances "to fuel its own profits at the expense of public health and safety."

entries.title: Cornell suspends frat parties after gang rape case
entries.snippet: Cornell said no parties will be held at frat houses until the end of the academic year. The university is trying to mend its reputation following its handling of a gang rape case in 2024.

entries.title: OpenAI says employee caught planting listening device
entries.snippet: A Saudi national employed by the artificial intelligence lab has been arrested after a listening device was planted in a company conference room.

entries.title: Vatican confirms Pope Leo underwent surgery for lung cancer
entries.snippet: The pope has had part of his lung removed and is recovering after surgery. Leo has been unusually candid for a pontiff about his health issues, disclosing the surgery to thousands of people in St. Peter's Square.

entries.snippet: Former Los Angeles gang leader Duane "Keffe D" Davis was found guilty of ordering the killing of hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur

entries.title: Germany news: Left-leaning Berlin coalition talks break down
entries.snippet: The SPD and Greens in Berlin have halted exploratory coalition talks with the Left Party amid a dispute over Israel policy and antisemitism. DW has more.

entries.title: Ukraine allies in Poland after Starlink sabotage, Trump diesel deal
entries.snippet: Germany's Johann Wadephul said hybrid plots like the Starlink fire showed Europe was "in Russia's crosshairs." The UK's Ed Miliband said Trump's Russian diesel deal led to a "very difficult few days" diplomatically.

entries.title: Ukraine and the US: What's next after Trump's diesel deal with Russia?
entries.snippet: Donald Trump plans to allow the purchase of Russian diesel, drawing criticism at home and abroad. What is behind the US president’s decision and what should Ukraine do next? DW spoke with experts.

entries.title: Iran seeking 'harder targets' for attacks abroad, UK warns
entries.snippet: The warning from the head of the UK's domestic security agency comes after PM Burnham said an attempted plot at an air force base hosting US bombers was "almost certainly" coordinated in Tehran.

entries.title: Saudi Arabia's military struggle against Houthi attacks
entries.snippet: Houthi attacks on airports and energy facilities are putting Saudi Arabia under pressure. Could a Saudi-led international military offensive succeed against the Iran-aligned Houthi militia in Yemen?

entries.title: How will emergency rule in Pakistan's northwest affect Afghan ties?
entries.snippet: Pakistan's decision to suspend Khyber Pakhtunkhwa's provincial government could further strain already tense relations between Islamabad and Kabul.

entries.title: Kimberly Guilfoye: US ambassador to Greece resigns amid misconduct allegations
entries.snippet: Kimberly Guilfoyle has resigned as US ambassador to Greece. President Trump previously said he was unhappy with her amid reports of a bribery scandal and ethics violations.

entries.title: Hungary's parliament votes to reverse anti-LGBTQ legislation from Orban era
entries.snippet: Hungary's parliament passed a bill amending the 2021 "child protection law." The move is considered the first significant reversal of Orban's curbs targeting the LGBTQ+ community.

entries.title: DR Congo: Kabila’s move towards M23 raises questions over peace
entries.snippet: Former DR Congo President Joseph Kabila has joined a new political-military front that brings together the Rwandan-backed AFC/M23 coalition. Analysts say it could reshape opposition to President Felix Tshisekedi.

entries.title: India: Can 'cockroaches' threaten Modi's political grip?
entries.snippet: Thousands detained, leaders arrested on arrival, and a capital under lockdown: The youth-led protests against the election chief have the attention of the Indian government. But experts say toppling it is another matter.

entries.title: Nuremberg airport briefly closed after in-flight emergency
entries.snippet: Police are investigating a suspected in-flight emergency on a Corfu flight. After the airport reopened, the airline said they believed the emergency code was a result of a technical malfunction.

entries.title: Nord Stream: Germany puts suspected Ukrainian pipeline saboteur on trial
entries.snippet: A Ukrainian citizen faces court in Hamburg, accused of attacking the Nord Stream gas pipelines in 2022. It raises questions about Kyiv's possible role in the explosions. German support for Ukraine is also under scrutiny.

entries.title: Critics warn of espionage risks as Slovakia restores military-diplomatic representation with Russia
entries.snippet: Slovakia is restoring military-diplomatic relations with Russia for the first time since 2022. The government has defended the move but critics warn of espionage risks and further damage to trust within NATO.

entries.title: Houthis and Saudis strike each other in latest escalation
entries.snippet: Fighting has continued between Iran-backed rebels and Saudi Arabia, adversely impacting the kingdom's economy and security. Still, Saudi officials have stopped warning of Houthi attacks in an effort to calm fears.

entries.title: Spain's King Felipe and Queen Letizia visit Ceuta
entries.snippet: The royal couple have arrived for their first-ever visit to the exclave to show solidarity with residents.
